title: The scientific method is a cycle
caption: Results feed back into new observations and questions, so investigation is a cycle rather than a straight line. Evidence can support a hypothesis but never prove it; one well-replicated contradictory result can refute it.
alt: Six boxes in a loop: observation, hypothesis, prediction, experiment, analysis and conclusion, communication, and back to observation.
description: Prediction: what should happen if it is right.
Analysis and conclusion: supported or refuted?.
Communication leads to new observations, closing the loop.
